description: This file defines a UI component class for managing display settings in a web application, including locators for various setting sections and methods to interact with them.

classes.name: DisplaySettings
classes.description: A class representing the display settings UI component, providing locators and methods to interact with display settings sections.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes locators for display settings UI elements based on the provided container.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Asserts that the display settings container is visible.

methods.name: expandSection
methods.description: Clicks on a section title to expand that section and verifies it is expanded.

methods.name: verifySectionIsExpanded
methods.description: Checks that a specific section is in the expanded state.
